title: Simple, engaging and effective, but some key flaws
body:
I really love using this app and feel motivated to improve my habits as a result. It’s engaging and intuitive, but I had to stop using it for almost 2 years due to a key flaw.
 
The app is really poor at storing stats, as any change to a habit results in all habit history being reset. As someone who wants to measure my progress over time, and change my habit goals, this is incredibly frustrating.

As an example, you track your exercise days and have a month of activity logged. You meet your goal of exercising 3 days per week, and a result increase the target to 4 days per week. The app will reset all your habit data if you make this change, and now you can’t see your progress since you started. 

This app is supposed to enable users to improve their habits and grow, but it fails at this when it feels like you are starting from scratch after every change to a habit. If they can fix this I’ll be a user for life, but it’s a dealbreaker

title: Productivity is a life saver
body:
For people with ADD /ADHD, as well as people who have an issue with breaking out of phone addiction or simply try to build up a routine and keep up with it without having to remember everything by themselves. This is like a manager that tells you what to do at the perfect time. I highly recommend this to everyone!

I have a small improvement suggestion: for people who bought the full version, like me, it would be cool, if "multiple reminders" were still coming even if they marked it as done earlier that day. I would like to remind myself to stand up regularly from my desk, also to drink a glass of water regularly - i am aware of the boost mode, but it is only available for one habit at a time which is not enough for me. I thought about creating the same habit with the same title multiple times for different times a day but I was wondering if there could be the possibility of an easier solution from your side! 
Best regards :)
